title: The Prom of the quarry
author: Sebastian Montrose
blurb: Isandro Whitlock, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
